notes.title: Fixed bug/crash from last update + troubleshooting tips
notes.content:
Last update introduced a bug that would crash NP on the main menu- sorry about that-

Fixed that bug and changed all other parts of the code that were susceptible to the same bug-

In the future if you're getting crashes, you can go to the other settings menu and press the "Delete saved data and quit" button on the bottom right
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KoLBRJw.jpeg[/img]

Then try launching NP again-

If that doesn't fix the issue press the "Show Player Log" button

Copy the "Player" file and send it to me/post somewhere I can access in one of these places

[url=https://discord.gg/twSWUXrY4p]The bug report channel on our Discord[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1355310/discussions/]On the NP Steam discussions page [/url]

[url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]Post it as an issue on our Github page[/url](requires free Github account)

notes.title: Added new scene + dolphins and nukes + more
notes.content:
Added a new scene by request from Jolsh---> "Passing Me By". Its a city street scene where a constant crowd of people walks past the actor.

Added scene fog that you can toggle off and on in the scene settings(3rd page)

Added some spawnable random things- use the Console(SHIFT + ESC) to access them.

Type "add" to see most all of the options including dolphins, crows, pigeons, hummingbirds, butterflies, vultures, seagulls, and raining money.

Type "Nuke" in the console and you'll find DropNuke- enter a number for the counting time like this "DropNuke 5" then press enter etc- 5 seconds will pass than a nuke will explode. The nuke will set fire to any rando's in the scene.

notes.title: You can now use your own models in Nightmare Puppeteer
notes.content:
Here's a video showing the basics of importing 3d models into Nightmare Puppeteer

[previewyoutube=FrTKkc1eAno;full][/previewyoutube]

With the latest build on the "testy" branch you can test this out today!

[url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/blob/master/Add3dModelsReadMe.md]Here's what you need to know[/url] about importing into Nightmare Puppeteer

[b]TLDR[/b]
[list]
*Fbx's for characters from these programs/sites supported- Daz 3d, iClone Character Creator, MakeHuman, Mixamo + any Blender, Maya etc humanoid model as long as you import them into a Unity project and generate a "rig definition" file using our [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/releases/tag/v1.0]free tool here[/url]

*Any fbx from any program is supported as a "prop"
*We made a[url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/releases/tag/v1.0] free script [/url]to convert virtually any humanoid 3d model that will work in Unity into an NP body or head
*We will make tutorials for this stuff and update the manual with it as soon as we finish adding the other new features

[/list]

Your character model does not need to be just a body or a head. You import complete models and NP will sever their heads or bodies for you. We do what we can.

To use your model again without having to re-import it, add it to NP's Steam Workshop by clicking the upload button after importing. A benefit of this is that others can use your models.

*NOTE - as far as I've seen Steam Workshop has TONS of copyrighted models in it so I don't think anyone cares as long as they are not sold. So upload Shrek or Batman or whatever the fuck you want ^_^

We'll be updating the import stuff regularly for the next week or two until the other new features are done before we go to work on our next animated feature film.

** This stuff is still in testing so expect bugs- please report them as comments to this post or here on [url=https://github.com/mdotstrange/NightmarePuppeteerPublic/issues]our github issues page[/url]. Thanks!

notes.title: Put your live self into your Nightmares!
notes.content:
We just updated Nightmare Puppeteer to v1.1.3

You can now add live webcam video sources to your scenes that have video objects in them. We also added two new video screen objects to the Lousy Level Editor so you can add live or pre-made videos to any scene where ever you'd like.

Check the newest tutorial to show you how.
[previewyoutube=237oRPWuLzk;full][/previewyoutube]

We also improved the way animation sets are switched + fixed them up a little as well.

You can use these commands to switch your animation sets while in a scene

* Previous animation set = ALT + Q
* Next animation set = ALT + A

Go make everything stranger!
